packageRules.description: Providers and modules come from the OpenTofu registry. Renovate defaults to Terraform's, whose hashes do not match what tofu init writes into the lock file.
required_version names an OpenTofu release. Renovate otherwise reads it as a Terraform version and offers Terraform's releases.
The OpenTofu binary in mise.toml and required_version move together: either one alone leaves CI running a version the other refuses.
Subject prefix for the OpenTofu configuration: the provider and required_version.
Subject prefix for the local toolchain in mise.toml.
Subject prefix for the workflows' action pins and the Renovate image itself.
